- Keith suggested Elizabeth consider talking to a professional, saying an external perspective can sometimes help. Elizabeth said she had thought about it but was unsure and hesitant about seeking help.
- Afterward, Keith observed Elizabeth become slightly withdrawn. He thought his suggestion might have embarrassed her and felt regretful.
- Keith told Elizabeth he hoped he had not overstepped, and that he wanted her to know he was there to support her no matter what. Elizabeth told him he had not overstepped, that she appreciated his concern, and that it was just a lot to think about.
- After their last conversation, Keith observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative of his concern. He believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him.
- Keith told Elizabeth he was glad they could talk and that he is always there if she needs to chat or take a break. Elizabeth thanked him, said it meant a lot, and said she felt better knowing she had his support.
- Keith intends to maintain this supportive relationship with Elizabeth.
